rules: A station's request DELIVERY-008/requests/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<station>.json is read only from that station's own branches (branch_re); copies on other branches are ignored.
ids: inclusive 008-NNN number ranges the station may deliver. null = not yet assigned: any 008 number outside every other station's ranges.
Only the repository owner edits this file (it lives on the protected default branch of opc-video-deliveries).
